sql.cobros:
select COALESCE(SUM(ve.valor_total),0) as valor_total
from valores_externos as ve
left join clientes_potenciales as cp on ve.id_cliente = cp.idclientes_potenciales
where LOWER(TRIM(ve.mes)) = 'junio'
  and ve.`año` = 2026
  and CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(COALESCE(cp.fecha_arriendo, '')), '-', 1)) = 4 THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(COALESCE(cp.fecha_arriendo, '')), '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED) ELSE CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(COALESCE(cp.fecha_arriendo, '')), '-', 1) AS UNSIGNED) END = 7;
sql.dashboard:
select COALESCE(SUM(p.vtotal),0) as suma_total_vtotal
from sg_proform as p
where p.mes = 6
  and p.anio = 2026;
